pages.text: $(bold)Tools and armour$() in every metal. Ironworks makes copper, bronze, brass and steel. Tin is early; lead heavy (shrugs off knockback); silver enchantable and bites the undead; nickel lasts.$(br2)Aluminum is light and fast; electrum fastest and most enchantable, but fragile; constantan the workhorse; invar hard-wearing; platinum near diamond.

$(bold)Lead$(): shot, ship cannonballs, pipes$(br)$(bold)Silver$(): electrum, electron tubes$(br)$(bold)Aluminum$(): aircraft hulls, propellers$(br)$(bold)Platinum$(): engines, precision mechanisms$(br)$(bold)Bronze$(): cannons, ship guns

$(bold)Constantan$(): thermometers, telescopes$(br)$(bold)Invar$(): the hearth, aircraft boilers$(br)$(bold)Electrum$(): transmitters, content observers$(br)$(bold)Tin$(): lanterns$(br2)Silver and platinum are the rare ones, and electrum needs silver.

Alloys mix in a $(bold)heated basin$(): electrum is gold + silver, constantan copper + nickel, invar two iron + nickel. Every metal also has a storage block.$(br2)Smiths, armorers and clerics buy the rarer metals for emeralds, bounty boards ask for them, and Spartan Weaponry makes weapons of all of them.
